sourceRefs.locator: Opening paragraph on the commemorative plaque at Pino Suárez and República de El Salvador, the comparison of possible locations and the concluding identification of the southern approach to Tenochtitlan, 8 November 1519.

Book XII, chapter 16. Opening place-names, garlands and necklaces, Moteuczoma’s welcome, Marina interpreting the answer, and the list of the lords accompanying Moteuczoma. This English excerpt presents the later Nahua account.
Second letter to Charles, excerpt pp. 85–89. Bridge and removable beams; attendants prevent physical contact; later speech in the lodging as reported to Charles.
Bibliographic note Segunda Carta. The letter is dated 30 October 1520 in Segura de la Frontera; first printed at Seville in 1522.
